'''Knossa''' was a major [[city]] that, according to the quasi-historical [[Qel-Droma Epics]], existed on the [[Jedi]] [[planet]] [[Ossus]]. According to the Epics, Knossa was built from stone and [[bronzium]], and its squat domes were located high in the western [[Eocho Mountains]]. Knossa supposedly consisted of the [[Eye of Ashlanae]], a powerful [[The Force|Force]] [[vergence]] on one of its peaks, and [[Knossa Spaceport]], which resembled a sprawling promenade wrapped around [[Agorn Mountain]], which was originally built to support [[pilgrim]]s visiting the nearby Eye of Ashlanae.<ref name="NoP" />
